By way of the present application, the applicant seeks extension of interim bail for a period of two months in case arising out of FIR No.62/2020, registered at Police Station Sarita Vihar, Delhi under Section 376/354/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC') and Sections 6/8 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (hereafter 'POCSO Act')
2.
